'''Crystalweeds''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. They were harvested by the [[Elom/Legends|Eloms]] in their [[sevriinas]].
